name: Wendelstein 7-X standard configuration vacuum field lines

coordinates.renderMapping: To y-up renderer: [x,y,z] -> [x,z,-y], a proper rotation preserving handedness.

method.field: Biot-Savart sum of exact finite straight current segments
method.integration: fourth-order Runge-Kutta using toroidal angle as independent variable
method.magneticAxis: Periodic orbit solved for the one-field-period return map of the same filament field.

source.geometry: Simsopt W7-X coil-zoo Fourier centerlines, order 48, with fivefold and stellarator symmetry; current signs follow Simsopt coils_via_symmetries.
source.boundary: Published W7-X standard EIM beta=0/current=0 VMEC input from the IPP Geiger database, distributed by Simsopt.

limitations: Vacuum thin-filament approximation: finite winding-pack cross sections, coil leads, trim/error coils, plasma pressure and plasma current are omitted.
Fourier coil curves are discretized into 1024 straight segments each; numerical convergence of integration and field evaluation does not bound physical model error.
Six toroidal circuits demonstrate bounded traced segments within this model, not a proof of global confinement or stability.
Trajectories follow magnetic field lines, not particle orbits. Animated travel along them is schematic; drifts, gyration, collisions and electric fields are absent.
Paths are open finite trajectory excerpts; do not connect their endpoints. The supplied plasma boundary is a published equilibrium surface, not the engineering vacuum-vessel wall.

verification.integrationCheck: Four representative lines repeated with half angular RK4 step over all six toroidal circuits.
verification.containmentCheck: Each trajectory sample tested against a 512-vertex cross section of the supplied published VMEC standard EIM boundary at the same toroidal angle.
